records.text: Candace Owens claimed that someone was on the Losee Center rooftop after the alleged shooter left and before Officer Christopher Bagley arrived at 12:44 p.m.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The person you say shot Charlie Kirk jumped off. Was there anybody on that rooftop before you got on at 1244 p.m.? And the answer is yes.

verification.notes: Bagley testified that he reached the roof at 12:44 p.m. and that an armed person in civilian clothing accompanied him, but he did not know that person's identity or agency. The hearing transcript does not establish that this person, or anyone else, was on the roof after the alleged shooter left but before Bagley arrived. Bagley also testified that he had not checked the interval in the manner defense counsel asked. No current authoritative source located independently confirms Owens's asserted sequence, so it remains attempted/unverifiable rather than false.

verification.notes: The transcript directly confirms that Owens accused Bagley of inadequate preparation and investigation. Current hearing testimony supplies partial factual predicates: Bagley said he did not know the identity or agency of the armed plainclothes person accompanying him, did not know why the body-camera battery died beyond his belief, and had not checked whether another person entered the roof during the interval asked about. Whether those answers amount to failure to prepare or investigate is an evaluative accusation, not an independently established fact.
